use_case_summary: PebblePort wants to add AI-driven ticket summarization and automated suggested replies into their Zendesk-based flow. Primary ask: reliable structured JSON outputs (category, urgency, suggested_reply, KB_hits) and the ability to call internal tools/APIs to enrich responses (order status, account metadata). Prefers self-serve hosted API in public cloud to get started quickly; cost-sensitive and will route less-critical workloads to smaller models.
requirements_detail: Workloads: real-time agent assist + nightly batch summarization of closed tickets.
Latency: p95 < 400ms for agent assist responses; embedding lookups <100ms desirable.
Throughput: bursty (10-60 rps during peak support hours).
Accuracy: category + priority classification > 85% in initial POC; suggested_reply should be high precision for agent acceptance.
Structured output: strict JSON schema to map to Zendesk custom fields.
Tool calling: must support secure outbound webhooks to their internal order-status microservice (token auth).
Auditability: want request/response logs for debugging (retention 90 days).
latency_targets: p95 < 400ms for agent responses; <100ms for embed lookups
routing_needs: Fallback to cheaper gen model for low-priority tickets; region routing to us-east for lowest latency.
